title: Ethiopian Culinary Culture
origins: Ethiopian cuisine reflects africa geography, trade routes, and home cooking traditions passed through generations.
history: Bold spice blends, slow stews, and starch scoops — communal eating is central.
teaching: Bloom berbere or ras el hanout in oil; long simmer with legumes; acid from lime or tamarind at finish.
Spice blends, palm or peanut oil, and injera or rice as base.
Signature pairing: berbere + injera + niter kibbeh.
